blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Backed Assets retains transfer-agent freeze and burn authority over bIB01 balances under its Swiss DLT Act framework and operates KYC-gated primary issuance.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: Backed announced Chainlink CCIP as its interoperability infrastructure for moving Backed tokens across blockchains, but on-chain reads on 2026-07-20 confirm the seven live bIB01 deployments are independently mintable issuer-native transparent proxies (shared implementation and ProxyAdmin, chain-local owners), so no bridge representation currently carries the supply.
bridgeRouteRisk.reviewer: Codex bridge route review; Kimi P2 control cohort dc-5 (lead usd1-world-liberty-financial)
